ch5_opening.speaker: beata
ch5_opening.text: This is as far as I go. Follow the valley path down. Past the old road, past the banana groves, to the empty houses at the edge of the marsh. From there, the river.

ch5_opening.speaker: beata
ch5_opening.text: No road is guaranteed safe. Keep close, help when you can, and don't let panic make the decisions.

ch5_opening.speaker: beata
ch5_opening.text: I will look in on him. And I will keep looking for Olivier. Go, while it is still dark enough to hide in.

ch5_beata_bye.speaker: beata
ch5_beata_bye.text: Go. Keep close to each other.

ch5_aline.speaker: aline
ch5_aline.text: Keep walking. If we stop to think about it, I don't think I'll be able to start again.

ch5_gasana.speaker: gasana
ch5_gasana.text: Don't slow down for me, Emmanuel. My legs are slow, but they are stubborn.

ch5_solange.speaker: solange
ch5_solange.text: I keep looking at every face we pass. In case one of them is my mother.

ch5_claudine.speaker: claudine
ch5_claudine.text: Eric is counting his steps. It helps him. I think it helps me too.

ch5_innocent.speaker: narrator
ch5_innocent.text: A man is sitting against the tree beside the path, holding his leg. The cloth he has wrapped around it is dark and wet.

ch5_innocent.speaker: innocent
ch5_innocent.text: Please. Don't be afraid. I can't walk any further. I've been here since yesterday.

ch5_innocent.speaker: aline
ch5_innocent.text: We can't help everyone we meet.

ch5_innocent.speaker: emmanuel
ch5_innocent.text: We can still help the person in front of us. Let's do what we can.

choices.text: [Use medicine] Ask Aline to clean and bind the wound.
[Give water] Leave him water and keep going.

ch5_innocent.speaker: narrator
ch5_innocent.text: Aline kneels. Her hands are steady. She cleans the wound, binds it tight, and helps him stand.

ch5_innocent.speaker: innocent
ch5_innocent.text: I thought no one would stop. Thank you for stopping.

ch5_innocent.speaker: innocent
ch5_innocent.text: My name is Innocent. If you will have me, I will walk with you. Slowly.

ch5_innocent.speaker: innocent
ch5_innocent.text: I thought no one would stop. Thank you for stopping.

ch5_innocent.speaker: innocent
ch5_innocent.text: Go on. My brother said he would come back for me. I will wait for him here.

ch5_innocent.speaker: narrator
ch5_innocent.text: They walk on. Emmanuel does not look back, and then he does.

ch5_family_call.speaker: narrator
ch5_family_call.text: Planks have been nailed across the door of the house. From inside, a woman's voice, very quiet.

ch5_family_call.speaker: mother
ch5_family_call.text: Is someone there? Please. They nailed us in two days ago. My children are with me.

ch5_family_call.speaker: aline
ch5_family_call.text: Emmanuel, if anyone comes down the path while we're here—

ch5_family_call.speaker: mother
ch5_family_call.text: God bless you. There should be a hoe or a pole somewhere by the field.

ch5_family_wait.speaker: mother
ch5_family_wait.text: Are you still there? Please hurry.

ch5_pole.speaker: narrator
ch5_pole.text: An old hoe handle lies by the edge of the field. It will do.

ch5_family_free.speaker: narrator
ch5_family_free.text: Emmanuel works the hoe handle under the first plank. The nails shriek. Everyone freezes. Nothing. The second plank. The third.

ch5_family_free.speaker: narrator
ch5_family_free.text: A woman and two children step out into the grey light, blinking.

ch5_family_free.speaker: mother
ch5_family_free.text: My name is Mukamana. I will never forget your faces.

ch5_family_free.speaker: mother
ch5_family_free.text: We are going to the marsh. People are hiding there in the papyrus. But listen: when you reach the river, cross where the water is wide and quiet. Never where it is narrow and fast.

ch5_rest.speaker: narrator
ch5_rest.text: They sit on the fallen tree, close together, listening to the valley.

ch5_rest.speaker: aline
ch5_rest.text: Everyone eats a little and drinks a little. Not more. We don't know how long this will take.

ch5_rest.speaker: aline
ch5_rest.text: We have nothing left to share. We'll have to keep going hungry.

ch5_rest.speaker: gasana
ch5_rest.text: Ah. My legs say thank you.

ch5_rest.speaker: aline
ch5_rest.text: There's a road ahead. A dirt road. I heard voices on it earlier. We should go around through the tall grass.

ch5_rest.speaker: emmanuel
ch5_rest.text: Stay low, all of you. Do exactly what I do.

ch5_stranger_early.speaker: narrator
ch5_stranger_early.text: Something moves in the banana grove, then goes very still.

ch5_stranger.speaker: narrator
ch5_stranger.text: Deep in the grove, a boy of about fifteen is crouched between the trunks, holding a stick like a weapon he does not know how to use.

ch5_stranger.speaker: jean
ch5_stranger.text: Stay back! Are you with them? Are you with the roadblock?

choices.text: "No. We're running too. We're trying to reach the river."

ch5_stranger.speaker: jean
ch5_stranger.text: Everyone says that. Everyone says they're not with them.

ch5_stranger.speaker: aline
ch5_stranger.text: Jean? Jean from the school in town? It's Aline. I used to help your sister with her lessons.

ch5_stranger.speaker: jean
ch5_stranger.text: Aline? They took my sister away on the second day. I don't know where.

ch5_stranger.speaker: jean
ch5_stranger.text: I haven't eaten in three days.

choices.text: [Share food] Give Jean some of the group's food.
"We have almost nothing left. I'm sorry."

ch5_stranger.speaker: jean
ch5_stranger.text: Thank you. I'll pay you back one day. I swear it.

ch5_stranger.speaker: jean
ch5_stranger.text: I understand. Nobody has anything any more.

ch5_stranger.speaker: jean
ch5_stranger.text: The empty houses past the grove. Nobody goes there now. A woman from the next hill, Vestine, brings water to people hiding there. She's kind.

ch5_stranger.speaker: jean
ch5_stranger.text: I'm not coming with you. I'm going back for my sister. Don't try to stop me.

ch5_end.speaker: narrator
ch5_end.text: The empty houses stand at the edge of the marsh, doors open, nobody inside. As the light goes, a woman comes up the path carrying a water jug.

ch5_end.speaker: vestine
ch5_end.text: Don't be afraid. My name is Vestine. I bring water to the people who hide here. Drink.

choices.text: "Thank you. We'll only stay one night."

ch5_end.speaker: aline
ch5_end.text: I know. That's what frightens me.

ch5_end.speaker: vestine
ch5_end.text: One night. Then go, quickly. It is better that way.

ch5_end.speaker: narrator
ch5_end.text: They sleep in the abandoned house, all of them in one room, taking turns to keep watch.
